changeSet.sql:
create table lti_registration ( id bigint not null auto_increment, education_resource_id bigint not null, issuer varchar(512) not null, client_id varchar(255) not null, deployment_id varchar(255) null, authorization_endpoint varchar(1024) not null, token_endpoint varchar(1024) not null, jwks_uri varchar(1024) not null, created_at datetime(6) not null, primary key (id), unique key ux_lti_registration_education_resource (education_resource_id), unique key ux_lti_registration_issuer (issuer), constraint fk_lti_registration_education_resource foreign key (education_resource_id) references education_resource (id) ) engine = InnoDB default charset = utf8mb4 collate = utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
create table lti_registration_invite ( id bigint not null auto_increment, token_hash char(64) not null, created_by_user_id bigint not null, created_at datetime(6) not null, expires_at datetime(6) not null, used_at datetime(6) null, lti_registration_id bigint null, primary key (id), unique key ux_lti_registration_invite_token_hash (token_hash), constraint fk_lti_registration_invite_user foreign key (created_by_user_id) references user (id), constraint fk_lti_registration_invite_registration foreign key (lti_registration_id) references lti_registration (id) ) engine = InnoDB default charset = utf8mb4 collate = utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

rollback.sql: drop table lti_registration_invite; drop table lti_registration;
